optAdvancedIntro.message: Choosing another folder and the helper itself are optional features: they need the local helper, not yet distributed through the store. Without it, the extension is fully functional and saves to Downloads/$1, and transcription through the provider API works all the same.

optAdvancedFolder.message: Choosing the recordings folder (any folder on the computer, the same for every profile) needs the local helper, not yet distributed through the store.

optAdvancedTranscription.message: Transcribing each call when it ends, on your own computer, needs the local helper, not yet distributed through the store.

optSavingToDownloadsHint.message: One folder per call, with the audio (audio.webm) and the call details (info.json). To choose another folder, see Advanced.

trAutoLabel.message: Transcribe each call automatically when it ends

trAutoHint.message: On your computer, right after saving: transcricao.md and transcricao.srt show up in the call folder. With this engine, nothing leaves your computer.

trModelLabel.message: Model (empty: the helper looks for the best one in ~/.cache/whisper-models and the usual folders)

trEngineLocalHint.message: Transcribes on this machine. Nothing leaves your computer. Requires the local helper (whisper.cpp, ffmpeg and a model of a few GB), which is not distributed through the store yet.

trEngineApiHint.message: The extension sends the call audio to OpenAI's server and gets the text back. Works without installing anything: just your key.

trApiPrivacy.message: Heads up: with this engine on, the call audio, including the participants' voices, is sent to OpenAI's server to be transcribed. The key stays on this machine only, in this Chrome profile. Only record and transcribe a call with the consent of everyone in it.

trApiCost.message: Costs about US$$ $1 per hour of call, billed by OpenAI to your account.

trApiLimit.message: A call over $1 is not sent (that is the API limit per request, about 1 h 49 in the format we record): the recording keeps the notice and the local engine transcribes it.

trApiKeyHint.message: The key is stored on this machine only, in this profile, and is used only in the request header to the provider. It never goes into info.json, the log or any error message.

trApiKeyMissing.message: Paste the API key before turning this on.

trApiEndpointHint.message: Empty uses the provider's address. Only an address of the declared provider is accepted.

trApiSaved.message: API transcription saved for this profile.

trApiPermissionDenied.message: Without permission to access $1 nothing is sent, and the API engine stays off.

trApiReady.message: Done: the next calls in this profile are transcribed through the API.

trApiOff.message: Off: no call in this profile is sent to the API.

trSitApiNoPermission.message: Access to $1 still needs your permission. Without it, nothing is sent.

stepMacLabel.message: Check that this is a Mac: the program that transcribes only has a macOS installer.

stepMacCheck.message: `uname -s` answers Darwin. On any other system, stop and tell me the installer only exists for macOS.

stepDepsLabel.message: Node 22, whisper.cpp and ffmpeg, installed with Homebrew.

stepDepsCheck.message: `node --version` is 22 or newer, `whisper-cli --help` answers (it lives in /opt/homebrew/bin/whisper-cli) and `ffmpeg -version` answers.

stepProjectLabel.message: The extension project, downloaded from GitHub into $1.

stepModelLabel.message: The speech recognition model: a $1 download, the longest step.

stepModelCheck.message: the downloaded file is exactly $1 bytes. A truncated file makes whisper fail without explaining why.

stepHelperLabel.message: The link between the Chrome extension and the program that transcribes.

stepHelperCheck.message: the command finished without errors and the id $1 appears in the host manifest it wrote.

stepProofLabel.message: A test call, spoken by the Mac itself, to prove transcription works end to end.

stepProofCheck.message: the test finished saying it passed. It runs in a temporary folder and never touches my recordings.

stepVerifyLabel.message: A final check, which shows what is ready and which folder my recordings will land in.

stepVerifyCheck.message: the last line starts with "Tudo pronto" (this command speaks Portuguese). It only reads, never changes anything, and it ends with an error when a piece is missing.

promptTitle.message: Install local transcription for the Gravador de Calls extension

promptIntro.message: I am on macOS and I want my calls transcribed on my own computer, without sending the audio anywhere. The Gravador de Calls extension is already installed in Chrome. What is missing is the program that transcribes and the link between the two. Please do it for me.

promptRuleStepByStep.message: Check each step before starting the next one, and tell me what you found.

promptRuleBigDownload.message: Warn me before the big download (the speech model, $1) and wait for me to confirm.

promptRuleNoNpmInstall.message: Do NOT run npm install in this project. The program that transcribes, the worker and the test import only Node modules and relative paths, and npm run works without the node_modules folder. This saves hundreds of MB.

promptRuleExplain.message: If a step fails, stop and explain in plain language what went wrong and what I can do.

promptRuleNoDelete.message: Never delete a file of mine and never touch my recordings.

promptRuleNoPassword.message: If you need my password, stop and tell me the command to run. Do not ask for the password.

promptEndExplain.message: Translate the output of the last command for me, in plain language: what is ready and what is still missing.

promptEndFolder.message: Tell me which folder my recordings will land in, the one the command showed.

promptEndEngine.message: Tell me I do not need to configure anything in the extension: transcription on my computer is already on. I only have to open the settings, check that "Your computer" is selected under Transcription and see the words "Ready to transcribe".

optLabelSaved.message: Profile name saved: it applies to this profile's next recordings.

optAutoLeave.message: Leave and close the tab when the call empties

optConfirmHint.message: Auto-leave keeps checking the count during this time, so a wrong number for an instant doesn't make it exit. If you are alone, it exits right away.

vigiaExampleLimit.message: Example: in a call that reached $1 people, auto-leave exits when $2 or fewer remain, $3. If you are alone, it exits right away.

optConsentLink.message: What is recorded and the consent notice

welcomeIntro.message: Before the first recording, see what the extension does and confirm at the end of the page.

welcomeWhatRemote.message: Only the audio that comes from the other participants in Google Meet and Microsoft Teams calls, each tab in its own recording.

welcomeWhatNoMic.message: Never your microphone: your voice is not in the recording.

welcomeWhatAuto.message: Recording starts by itself when the call starts and ends when you leave. You can turn it off per platform in the settings, and the icon shows REC on the tab being recorded.

welcomeWhereDownloads.message: On your computer, in Downloads/$1: one folder per call, with the audio (audio.webm) and the call details (info.json).

welcomeWhereNothingLeaves.message: Nothing leaves the computer: the extension has no server, doesn't send the recordings to anyone and doesn't collect usage data.

welcomeConsentLaw.message: Recording a conversation may require the consent of every participant, depending on the country and the state. In Brazil, the LGPD treats voice as personal data; in some US states, every participant must agree to the recording.

welcomeConsentAdvice.message: Tell the participants before recording. You are responsible for using the recording according to the law where you and they are.

welcomeAckHint.message: Until you confirm, automatic recording stays off in this Chrome profile.

welcomeAcked.message: All set: automatic recording is on in this profile. You can close this tab.
